operands.name: session
operands.predicate: New York pullback after a pre-09:30 impulse

operands.name: pocket_low
operands.predicate: up-leg [H-0.618W, H-0.50W] of a defined impulse, not the 9-10 box
operands.page: F06 A4; RR-14; GB p.50 daily fib confirms the up-leg form

reference.verdict_rule: fail if no defined pre-09:30 up impulse

operands.name: pocket_low
operands.predicate: NY bar range overlaps the pocket

location.verdict_rule: fail if no NY pullback into the pocket

operands.name: near
operands.page: RR-14 stop at the near edge

trigger.verdict_rule: fail if the pocket is never touched after 09:30

operands.name: confirm_close
operands.predicate: first 5-minute close back out of the pocket in the impulse direction; labelled OD
operands.page: F06 A4 OD five-minute close out

operands.name: continuation_hold
operands.predicate: pullback close does not take the far 61.8% edge

confirmation.verdict_rule: fail if no close out of the pocket, or the pullback close is through the far edge

risk.verdict_rule: fail if stop is not the near edge beyond entry

operands.name: target
operands.page: F06 A4; SD04 pending targets straddle PDH

objective.verdict_rule: fail if target is not ahead of entry

bearish_small_scalp.verdict_rule: reference fail, observation scope, never a setup pass

bullish_discount_pullback.verdict_rule: reference fail, observation scope, never a setup pass
